# Terminal protocol provenance

`terminal_pb.ts` is the generated `protoc-gen-es` 2.16.0 schema from Paul Robello's MIT-licensed `par-term-emu-core-rust` web frontend. It is pinned to the v0.81.0 tag at core commit `8b3cc8d61f787b90b673180764ad6d2a3cb4b35b` and copied byte for byte from that tag. Against v0.78.1 it only adds optional fields: `Connected.paneCreateAllowed`, `Connected.cwdHostname`, `Connected.cwdIsLocal`, `CwdChanged.isLocal` and `PaneCreateRequest.name`. Older streamers leave them absent. It also includes the damage metadata and pane-create protocol messages, and keeps the existing generated message APIs. Runtime release and Apple Silicon artifact hashes are pinned in the project-root `core-release.json`.

SHA-256: `a726195a354a549da216b5a6ffd1faa8359a4e8f10d98d5e32bf56fb67d6c35b`.

The source of truth is core `proto/terminal.proto` at the pinned revision; its web frontend generation command is `bun run proto:generate`. The v0.77 protocol documents raw SGR bits 64 and 65, optional damage ranges/generation, and optional pane creation, but this client only vendors the generated compatibility surface for now. Update from a verified compatible core revision, preserve the generated file, and rerun the framing/metadata tests. The wrapper in `../protocol.ts` handles the existing one-byte compression flag and bounded zlib framing. It does not redefine the protobuf wire format.
